summary: Build tasks for the mock-first AI layer. Wave 0 lands the ModelClient, the in-process fake, the LLM fake server, fixtures, config switch, Paploo mock path, evals and the CI guard; every later task tests against them.

waves.1: one fixture + mock acceptance task per feature in features.json
waves.2: one e2e suite per area on the mock stack

tasks.title: kernel/ai: ModelClient contract, request/response types, usage accounting
accept: ModelClient, Request, Response, ToolCall, Usage, StreamEvent and Embedder exist exactly as spec/ai/mocks.md sec. 2 (CONTRACT header)
Every Request carries FeatureID; a Request without FeatureID -> ErrNoFeature
Usage is recorded per feature id (tokens in/out, cost micro-cents); no prompt or completion text is persisted (AI-R-005 test)

tasks.title: kernel/ai/aifake: deterministic in-process ModelClient for unit tests
accept: aifake.New(fixturesFS) answers Complete/Stream/Embed from testdata/ai/<feature>/ by feature id + prompt hash; unknown hash -> ErrNoFixture naming the hash and the closest fixture
Scripted tool calls come back as ToolCall values; scripted errors (429, 500, overloaded, timeout) come back as typed errors
Same input -> byte-identical output across 100 runs; embeddings are deterministic unit vectors from sha256 of the text

tasks.title: Fixture format, loader, prompt hash and fixture lint
accept: Fixture YAML (mocks.md sec. 4) loads; prompt hash = sha256 of canonical JSON of {feature, system, messages, tools} with volatile fields (ids, timestamps) masked
Lint: every features.json id has a fixture dir with ok, error_429, timeout, injection; missing one -> make check fails naming it
Lint rejects fixtures without synthetic: true

tasks.title: test/fakes/llm: Messages-protocol fake server (non-stream, stream, tools)
accept: POST /v1/messages returns the fixture turn: text, tool_use blocks, stop_reason, usage; stream=true emits message_start, content_block_delta (text and input_json_delta), message_delta, message_stop as SSE
Routing: header X-Counsel-Feature (or metadata.feature) + prompt hash; fallback rule match by regex on the last user turn; no match -> 404 with a JSON error naming the hash
GET /healthz and GET /v1/models; container healthcheck flag; no network calls out

tasks.title: test/fakes/llm: OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions and Responses protocol
accept: POST /v1/chat/completions and POST /v1/responses serve the same fixtures as /v1/messages (tool_calls, function_call output items, streamed chunks with [DONE], usage)
A protocol conformance test sends one fixture through all three protocols and gets the same text, tool name and tool arguments

tasks.title: test/fakes/llm: faults, latency, token usage and request journal
accept: Fixture or header X-Fake-Fault selects 429 (with retry-after), 500, 529 overloaded, mid-stream disconnect, malformed JSON, timeout; latency_ms and per-chunk delay honoured
usage tokens come from the fixture, else a deterministic estimate (len/4); GET /_journal returns feature id, hash, protocol, status and usage per call (no bodies unless -dump-bodies is set)
POST /_reset clears the journal and per-test sequence counters

tasks.title: test/fakes/llm: embeddings endpoint
accept: POST /v1/embeddings returns deterministic vectors (dimension from config, default 1024) from sha256 of the input; fixture can pin vectors so named texts are near or far
Cosine of identical texts = 1; pinned near-duplicates >= 0.95; unrelated < 0.2

tasks.title: Config switch model.mode = mock | live, HTTP ModelClient, live guard
accept: model.mode defaults to mock in every config except deploy/counsel.prod.yaml; mock -> base URL of test/fakes/llm (or in-process aifake when model.base_url empty)
live requires model.mode=live, model.base_url and a vault key; COUNSEL_ENV in {test, ci} with live -> boot fails live_model_forbidden
/healthz reports model: mock|live; unit tests run with no network

tasks.title: Paploo plugin path on the mock: Paploo dev stack with test/fakes/llm
accept: Compose overlay starts paplood + agent container with container.anthropic_base_url = http://llm-fake:8080 (Counsel fake, Messages protocol); no real key mounted
A scripted run calls report_plan then draft_note through the Counsel app-API connector; Counsel has a pending matter.agent_note gate and Paploo has no gate row
Fixture keyed by feature id from the turn prompt header line "feature: F-..."; the claude CLI turn completes with no network beyond the fake

tasks.title: Eval runner reusing fixtures
accept: make eval runs every eval case against aifake by default and reports pass/fail per feature; --live is opt-in and refused in CI
Eval case = fixture input + assertions (tool sequence, gate kind, citations present, no decide call); injection cases from every fixture run in the red-team suite

tasks.title: CI guard: no live model anywhere in tests
accept: CI sets no model key and blocks egress to public model hosts; any test that builds a live client fails
Grep guard: no real model base URL or key env var in testdata/, test/, deploy/*.dev.yaml
